profile.headline: Applied AI @ WorkOS
profile.summary: Software engineer focused on building systems, internal tools, and workflows that enable teams to move faster and operate at scale. I’ve worked across product engineering, infrastructure, and go-to-market automation—leading projects like billing migrations, workflow orchestration, data enrichment pipelines, and internal platform development. I enjoy solving messy problems, shipping fast, and building tools that make a real difference across the company.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description: Tutor approximately 5 students weekly  in computer science and computer information sciences courses.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Worked on the Financial Services team developing a full-stack application to provide relevant 
   customer interactions data to over 5000 agents, who serve 1 million+ customers
- Collaborated with UX Designers to implement a front-end interface using TypeScript, 
   Angular,Node.js, HTML5, and CSS3
- Developed an Apache Kafka stream with Java and Spring Boot, and stored data in a 
   comprehensive database with Amazon DynamoDB

positions.title: HP Business Case Compettition
positions.description:
- Won 1st place in a 4-person team, competing against 80 other HBCUs worldwide
- Prepared and pitched a business case, answering the question “What is a transformative product or service that shows where the gaming market is going in the next five years?”
- Led the team in conducting market research and competitor analysis, enhancing the business proposal

positions.title: Software Engineering Summit Participant
positions.description:
- Created a web application with Flask framework (http://jacobia.pythonanywhere.com)
- Attended various technical training sessions ranging from MEAN Stack Development to Voice Driven Applications
- Participated in a rigorous hackathon, working on the frontend development of Capital One Community, an iOS app created to promote users to engage with the community through monetary incentives

positions.title: Facebook HBCU Business Summit Participant
positions.description:
- Nominated and selected as 1 of 10 participants in the professional development business summit for historically black colleges and universities (HBCUs)
- Networked with and receive 1-1 mentoring from Facebook employees/HBCU alumni

positions.title: Firmware Develpment Intern
positions.description:
-Worked with software engineers to write, debug and test x86 Firmware
-Managed builds and released Firmware to test, and recreated and resolved bugs reported by the test team
-Created, validated and maintained BIOS and UEFI code used on Intel x86 based Servers

positions.title: Peer Mentor for Computer Science Summer Institute
positions.description:
-Worked alongside Google Engineers for three weeks teaching incoming freshman who plan to study computer science basic programming concepts
-Served as a resident assistant for 45 campers, aiding them both in and outside of the classroom

positions.title: Google Computer Science Summer Institue Scholar
positions.description:
- One of 60 students selected from a 12,000 applicant pool to participate
- Developed and deployed a functional web application in four days using AppEngine with Python, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with JQuery
- Worked with and learned from Google engineers

organizations.name: Honors College
organizations.description: The University Honors Program is designed to enroll, reward, and prepare academically gifted students, encouraging them toward intellectual initiative and independence. Students are selected for their outstanding academic achievements and monitored throughout a strategic four-year matriculation that will prepare them to pursue advanced degrees in highly competitive graduate or professional programs and to assume leadership roles in their professions and in society.
